title: RQ-LIN: linear original copies with unflagged online replacement tolerance

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE RQ-LIN algorithm and exact parameter rule of proof.md recover all of s under ModelM of proof.md, including all-honest copies and every online unflagged replacement strategy with at most floor(Q/32) replacements among the actual Q acquired originals with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch including source rejections, discarded copies, numerical-label errors, failed quantum search trials and the acquisition abort, its total charged sequential work T is O(n^6 2^((1/2)n)). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2; the SAME fully specified algorithm at n=1 has finite costs absorbed by absolute outer constants. Its exact envelope growth index is 1. All constants are independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and joint 1/32 fractional-tolerance declaration for this same configuration.

This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2; the SAME fully specified algorithm at n=1 has finite costs absorbed by absolute outer constants. Its exact envelope growth index is 0. All constants are independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and joint 1/32 fractional-tolerance declaration for this same configuration.

For the SAME RQ-LIN algorithm/configuration as the four resource claims, the guaranteed malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=1/32 in the online unflagged replacement ModelM of proof.md and the exact error-model text below. For every N>=2,s and every admissible online strategy, at most floor(Q/32) of the ACTUAL Q acquired original copies may be arbitrary replaced states, including rejected and discarded copies; under this promise unconditional full-secret success is at least1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. Honest calls are fresh rho_s independent of prior systems, and each replacement decision precedes its current honest draw. No replacement flags are available. The all-honest clean case is included. This does not claim robustness to a different/offline model or a larger fraction.

structured.error_model: Online unflagged replacement model. Before each acquired copy, an adversary chooses a classical replacement bit using N, s, the past classical transcript and private quantum workspace, without access to the current fresh honest draw or future protocol coins. A non-replaced copy is a fresh rho_s tensor-independent of all prior systems; a replaced copy is any state on the same n+1 input qubits and may be entangled with private workspace and other replacements. No replacement flag is supplied. At termination Q is the actual count of all acquired copies, including rejects and discards, and at most floor(epsilon(n)*Q) were replaced almost surely for every admissible strategy; this is a promise, not postselection on budget fulfillment. Current honest labels cannot be inspected before deciding that call's type. All other gates and measurements are ideal. The probability is uniform over N,s and all such online strategies.
